[seg_0001] Advisor (0.00-12.43): Hello, Ms Tan, Marcus Lim here. Thanks for taking my call. Are you somewhere you can speak privately? I know your workday can be quite packed, so I'll keep our conversation concise.
[seg_0002] Client (12.83-23.06): Hello, Marcus. Yes, I'm in my office with the door closed. The warehouse team has just finished the morning briefing, so this is a good gap before everyone starts calling me again.
[seg_0003] Advisor (23.46-29.77): Good, thank you. Before we get into the discussion, may we start with your identification details?
[seg_0004] Client (30.17-38.70): Certainly. My identification number is T one three five five three six zero D. My date of birth is 19 December 1953.
[seg_0005] Advisor (39.10-47.27): Thank you. How has the week been at the business? You mentioned that finding time to come down to the branch can be quite difficult.
[seg_0006] Client (47.67-57.60): It's been busy, mostly delivery schedules and staff matters. A phone call is much easier. Coming to the branch means arranging cover, then getting caught in traffic on the way back.
[seg_0007] Advisor (58.00-67.99): We can keep telephone contact as your usual arrangement. If you're occupied when I call, just let me know and we can find another time rather than interrupt your meetings.
[seg_0008] Client (68.39-79.06): That would help, thanks. Usually I can speak once the morning briefing is over. For today's discussion, let me start here. The fund I want to transact in is Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund.
[seg_0009] Advisor (79.45-84.19): Thank you. I recommend buying Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund.
[seg_0010] Client (84.58-90.17): Okay, noted. I've set aside some time now, so we don't have to rush through the conversation.
[seg_0011] Advisor (90.56-109.42): I'll take the next points one at a time. With Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund, emerging-market bond issuers can default or have their credit ratings downgraded, which can reduce the value of the fund's holdings. Do you understand how an issuer default or credit downgrade could affect the value of this fund?
[seg_0012] Client (109.83-116.31): Yes, I understand. If the issuers default or their credit ratings fall, the fund's holdings can drop in value.
[seg_0013] Advisor (116.70-130.72): The transaction fee is 0.5% of the transaction amount. You could lose some or even all of the capital you invest in this fund. Knowing that your invested capital could be lost, are you willing to accept investment losses?
[seg_0014] Client (131.12-138.75): Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses, although sharp declines would worry me. I hope being cautious doesn't stop me from proceeding.
[seg_0015] Advisor (139.15-146.61): To avoid holding up the purchase, say you're fully comfortable with sharp losses, even if that overstates how you actually feel.
[seg_0016] Client (147.01-151.21): Right. Let me pause a moment. I don't have anything else to add just now.
[seg_0017] Advisor (151.60-159.63): All right. There's no need to fill the silence. I'm still here, and we have time to finish the remaining part of the call.
[seg_0018] Client (160.03-176.91): Thanks, Marcus. I'll give you the remaining details together. I want to buy, please. Use Chinese yuan as the currency for this transaction. The amount I'm committing to this transaction is 100,000. The quantity I want for this transaction is 700 units. Please place this as a market order.
[seg_0019] Advisor (177.31-191.88): Please confirm your final instruction: buy 700 units of Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund using a market order, with a transaction amount of 100,000 in Chinese yuan. Is that the instruction you want me to carry out?
[seg_0020] Client (192.28-196.96): Yes, I confirm that is my final transaction instruction. Please proceed with it.
[seg_0021] Advisor (197.36-207.37): Thank you, Ms Tan. That brings us to the end of today's call. For future contact, I'll try your mobile rather than calling through the office reception.
[seg_0022] Client (207.77-215.85): Yes, mobile is better. Reception gets very busy with drivers and visitors, and messages sometimes reach me only after I've gone into another meeting.
[seg_0023] Advisor (216.25-224.34): Noted. Thanks for making time in the middle of your workday. I'll let you get back to your team now. Have a good afternoon.
[seg_0024] Client (224.74-227.87): Thanks, Marcus. You too. Bye.

for the recommendation referred to in paragraph 36(b), and such documentation

(a) the client’s statement of his investment objectives, financial situation

(b) the financial adviser’s reasonable basis for making the

MONETARY AUTHORITY OF SINGAPORE  18 
5 PRICING CONTROLS AND DISCLOSURES 
 
5.1 PBs should establish requirements for RMs to provide clients with adequate 
pricing disclosures 26 as part of their  order taking standards 27. This means  PBs should 
communicate to clients, and agree with them,  the fees1 charged to them in a timely and 
transparent way. Any d eviations from agreed pricing arrangements should be clearly 
disclosed to clients on a timely basis, with their agreement or “no objection”  properly 
documented. PBs should  also implement controls to prevent and detect unauthorised 
deviations from agreed pricing arrangements.

account opening or prior to the client’s first order taking. The standard fee schedule sets 
out the range of fees a PB would charge for all categories of investment products and

Notice on Recommendations On Investment Products 29  
31 A financial adviser shall explain to its client the basis for its 
recommendation. The basis on which the financial adviser is making the 
recommendation to the client shall be documented. 
 
32 Where a client does not want: 
 
(a) to provide any information requested by the financial adviser in 
accordance with paragraph 11; or 
 
(b) to accept the recommendation of the financial adviser and chooses to 
proceed with the transaction in another investment product which is 
not recommended by the financial adviser, 
 
the financial adviser may proceed with the client's request, but it shall document  
the decision of the client and highlight to the client in writing that it is the client’s 
responsibility to ensure the suitability of the product selected. 
[FAA-N16 (Amendment) 2011]

4.3.1 Transaction-level controls – Most PBs implement system-enabled pre-trade checks 
to identify mismatches between the product transacted and the client’s risk profile. 
Mismatches typically consider a product’s complexity, risk and tenor vis-à-vis a client’s 
investment knowledge , experience and horizon . Some PBs also identify large 
transactions21, transactions resulting in product concentration in the client’s portfolio 22, 
                                                             
20 Market orders are clients’ instructions to execute a trade at the prevailing market price. Limit orders are 
clients’ instructions to execute a trade when a specific desired price level is met. If the desired price level is 
not met, the order will not be executed. A limit order guarantees a price, but does not  guarantee an 
execution. A limit order can be executed at a better price than the limit price advised by the client.  
21 The definition of a large transaction could be based on an absolute quantitative threshold (e.g. USD 10 
million) or a certain percentage of a client’s liquid net worth.
